label: Bible Study
note: The commandment against killing — four words in the KJV, about as short as law gets.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Let not your heart be _____: ye believe in God, believe also in me.
verse: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.
note: Spoken in the upper room, hours from betrayal — Jesus comforts them on His hardest night.

label: Sunday School
prompt: In the same hour came forth _____ of a man's hand, and wrote over against the candlestick upon the plaister of the wall of the king's palace: and the king saw the part of the hand that wrote.
verse: In the same hour came forth fingers of a man's hand, and wrote over against the candlestick upon the plaister of the wall of the king's palace: and the king saw the part of the hand that wrote.
note: Belshazzar's feast, interrupted: the original writing on the wall, delivered in person.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Thou therefore endure _____, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.
verse: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.
note: KJV 'hardness' is hardship — Paul, chained in Rome, recruits Timothy as a fellow soldier.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were _____ and ignorant men, they marvelled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus.
verse: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marvelled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus.
note: 'Unlearned and ignorant' — no rabbinic training, yet people could tell they'd been with Jesus.
